description:
ADR-0008 drew the line at builtins: typing shared, semantics twice. Beyond builtins and heads, Elixir mode re-derives the type of every node: `expr/2` (elixir_mode.ex ~L390-561, 32 clauses returning `{quoted, type}`), `coerce/3`, `settle_accs/3` + `note_u64_mix/3` (a hand copy of the compiler's u64 accumulator fixpoint, `u64_candidates/3` ~L4935), `body_type/3`, `trial/1` look-aheads at 4 sites; `State` holds `leaf_types`, `u64_cands`, `u64_hits` for typing alone. The ADR's reasoning (typing gains nothing from independence) applies to this remainder. Also vestigial: `definitions/3` sets `Ctx.set(:file, ...)` "so err! reads it", but nothing on Elixir mode's path reads the ctx.

This is a spike (settled 2026-10-19), not an implementation:
- Measure what `lower_kernel` can export as a node-to-type map (keyed by node meta or a typed AST), at what cost, given that the compiler's typing is interleaved with lowering.
- Deliverable: a comment on this ticket with the findings. If the seam exists, create an implementation child of the epic. If not, close with the finding and record in an ADR note (extend ADR-0008) that the remainder of typing stays twice, so the next review does not re-propose it.
- Either way, drop the dead `Ctx.set(:file)` write in a small PR.

Semantics stay written twice (ADR-0008 confirmed, not reopened). Last in the epic.

comments.text: Spike finding (2026-10-20). Seam: the compiler runs before Elixir mode on the same desugared kernels; a unique defk_id stamped into every node's meta after desugar keys a node (line+column fails: ~58k nodes of macro-built kernels have no column). Stamping left the C of all 108 modules byte-identical. Probe (lower_expr vs expr/2, mix dump_c): 58,361 keyed Elixir-mode typings, 57,877 (99.2%) equal the compiler's own lowering of the kernel; the rest: 71 bitstring vs [u8] naming, 35 typed twice by the compiler (u64 retries, case-in), 92 never through lower_expr (float trees), 286 in helpers that are only inlined; 24,068 literals need no key. Gain: ~100 of 1,549 lines (settle_accs, note_u64_mix, body_type, leaf_types, 3 State fields); expr/2's type plumbing and trial/1 (write discovery) stay. Against: the u64 accumulator inference decides results (3 - 5 raises as u64, -2 as i64), so sharing it retires the oracle's check of that decision (ADR-0008). Owner decision: close, extend ADR-0008; drop the dead Ctx.set(:file) write in the same PR.
PR #67: ADR-0008 extension + dead Ctx.set(:file) removal (definitions/2). Closes after the merge.

title: Spike: can the compiler hand Elixir mode its node types, so Elixir mode only emits?
